description: Randomly partitions the analysis channels into grpdiv mutually exclusive sets, then plays the sets ONE AT A TIME - each set sounds for setdur windows while all other channels are zeroed, cycling through the group before a new random partition is drawn. The file's timeline runs at its original rate; only WHICH channels sound changes. grpdiv must exactly divide the channel count: on a 1024-point analysis (512 usable) that means POWERS OF 2 - 6 is refused even though the refusal text says 'ERROR: Number of channel-sets must be a multiple of 2' (misleading; 8 and 512 accepted, banner's 'exact divisor' rule is the real one). DETERMINISTIC despite the randomness: no seed slot, and same-second + 1.3 s-apart pairs render byte-identically (fixed-seed drand48 shim; dev/new/glisten.c calls drand48 with no seeding) - hence version_sensitive. setdur and grpdiv both breakpoint-capable (each brk render differs from both scalar endpoints). Static duration (2.0230 / 1.5209). Operates on PVOC analysis files (.ana).
musical_use: Spectral scintillation - the sound flickers between complementary slices of itself, like light through leaves: at short setdur (1-10 windows, 3-30 ms) it is a shimmering grain-cloud in frequency; at long setdur (100+) it becomes slow chordal breathing as different channel families take turns. grpdiv sets how thin each slice is (2 = halves alternating, richer; 64 = sparse glittering threads). The three randomisers animate it: pitchshift scatters each set's pitch by up to +/-N semitones (chorus-to-cluster), durrand jitters the switching rhythm, divrand makes unequal set sizes so slices vary in weight. A setdur breakpoint sweeps from shimmer to breathing across the file. Fixed permutation per argv on this build - vary params slightly for a new draw; there is no seed.

grpdiv.description: Number of channel-sets to divide the analysis channels into; MUST exactly divide the channel count - powers of 2 on a standard 1024-point analysis ('6' refused with the misleading 'must be a multiple of 2' text; '0' refused quoting the range '(2.000000 to 512.000000)'). Breakpoint accepted and verified distinct from both endpoints (2-to-8 ramp) - intermediate non-divisor values are apparently tolerated inside a brk.

setdur.description: Number of windows each channel-set persists before switching (Range 1-1024, banner and refusal agree: '0'/'2000' refused verbatim quoting '(1.000000 to 1024.000000)'). ~2.9 ms per window at the default analysis. Breakpoint verified (10-to-60 ramp differs from both endpoints).

pitchshift.description: Maximum random +/- pitch shift applied per channel-set (Range 0-12, default 0; '-p13' refused verbatim: 'Parameter[3] Value (13.000000) out of range (0.000000 to 12.000000)'). Verified live and still deterministic (fixed shim).

durrand.description: Randomisation of setdur between 1 and setdur (Range 0-1; '-d1.5' refused verbatim, Parameter[4]). Verified live.

divrand.description: Randomises the number of channels per set within a group (Range 0-1; '-v1.5' refused verbatim, Parameter[5]); 0 = equal-sized sets. Verified live.

examples.expected_use: Eight thin channel families flickering every ~12 ms - glittering, granular light.

examples.description: Slow chordal breathing with pitch scatter.
examples.expected_use: Two halves of the spectrum alternate in ~0.6 s waves, each draw shifted up to +/-3 semitones with jittered timing.

known_issues: grpdiv's real rule is the banner's 'exact divisor of the channel count' (powers of 2 on a 1024-point analysis: 6 refused, 8/512 accepted); the refusal text 'must be a multiple of 2' is misleading - pinned divergence.

NO SEED and deterministic in practice: same argv renders byte-identically (same-second and 1.3 s-apart pairs verified; source uses the fixed-seed drand48 shim, no srand/initrand48 in dev/new/glisten.c). A different RNG substrate would change renders - version_sensitive.
grpdiv accepts breakpoint files (verified distinct render) even though a swept value passes through non-divisors - treat grpdiv brks as adventurous; setdur brks are the safe animation channel.
Zeroed-channel flicker can expose analysis artifacts on very tonal sources at extreme grpdiv - audition.
